actions.title: Fix Vercel video rewrites for all 334 catalog videos and emit HowToStep images
actions.score_rationale: 238 of 334 recipe and step video URLs routed to 404s in production because vercel.json only mapped 4 directories to tusharma88/tsp-videos, and 1,006 step images were omitted from HowToStep structured data.
actions.diagnosis: Catalog videos are split across tusharma88/tsp-videos (248 files) and tusharksharma/tusharksharma site-videos-2026-09 (85 files, plus 1 renamed meatball asset), while toHowToStep ignored step.images and step.image.
actions.proposed_change: Route the 66 site-videos-2026-09 directories and 2 file-level overrides explicitly in vercel.json with the default /videos/:recipe/:filename catch-all pointing to tusharma88/tsp-videos, verify all 334 videos in scripts/validate-seo-videos.js, and include step image URLs in toHowToStep.
actions.effort_assumptions: Release asset inventories are available via GitHub API and step image paths are already present in recipes.js and cookbook.js.
acceptance_tests: node scripts/validate-seo-videos.js verifies all 334 catalog video paths against the dual-release inventory with 0 missing assets.
Every pictured step in Recipe JSON-LD includes an absolute https://thesplitplate.com/images/... URL on its HowToStep object.

measurement.metric: Verified catalog video resolution rate and HowToStep image coverage in generated Recipe JSON-LD
measurement.baseline: 96/334 videos routed (238 broken); 0/1,006 pictured steps emitted HowToStep.image
measurement.proposed_target: 334/334 catalog videos routed and verified; 1,006/1,006 pictured steps emit HowToStep.image
measurement.comparison_window: Immediate build verification and post-deploy HTTP HEAD check; 28-day Search Console video/recipe rich result impressions once connected.
measurement.guardrail: Never emit broken video or image URLs or invent step images for text-only steps.

actions.priority_rationale: Broken media delivery and missing step images directly degrade user playback and rich-result media discovery across the entire catalog.

actions.title: Expand truthful Recipe JSON-LD duration parsing, cuisine inference, keywords, and author URL
actions.score_rationale: 48 recipes with explicit durations (parenthetical breakdowns or prep + cook) omitted totalTime in Recipe JSON-LD, 128 cookbook items omitted keywords, and recipeCuisine and author.url were missing.
actions.diagnosis: recipeTimings rejected any time string containing '+' or parentheses unless meta.totalMinutes was set, and buildRecipeSchema only read r.tags (ignoring cookbook r.bestFor) and omitted recipeCuisine and author.url.
actions.proposed_change: Parse explicit leading totals before parenthetical breakdowns and additive prep + cook segments into ISO-8601 prepTime, cookTime, and totalTime (while keeping overnight/range/unquantified strings omitted), infer conservative recipeCuisine, fall back to r.bestFor for keywords, and add author.url.
acceptance_tests: Valid ISO-8601 totalTime coverage increases from 44/60 to 54/60 dinners and 62/139 to 104/139 cookbook entries while overnight/range/unquantified times remain undefined.
node scripts/test-seo-fixes.js passes all 5 structured data assertions.

measurement.metric: Recipe JSON-LD recommended property completeness across 199 recipe routes
measurement.baseline: 106/199 recipes with totalTime; 0/199 with prepTime+cookTime; 0/199 with recipeCuisine; 71/199 with keywords
measurement.proposed_target: 158/199 recipes with truthful totalTime; 32 with explicit prepTime+cookTime; 76 with conservative recipeCuisine; 199/199 with keywords and author.url
measurement.comparison_window: Immediate build verification; 28-day Search Console Recipe enhancement report after deploy.
measurement.guardrail: Never fabricate durations for overnight chill, freeze, or unquantified steps, and never emit aggregateRating or single-number nutrition on split-lane dinners.

actions.priority_rationale: Structured data completeness directly governs Google Recipe rich-result eligibility and carousel attributes.

actions.title: Strip internal series prefixes and eliminate mid-sentence meta description truncation
actions.score_rationale: 41 cookbook items led descriptions and visible hooks with internal series labels (CrumblCreamiCut, Proffee Episode, Snack Box Series), and 96 of 199 recipe meta descriptions ended mid-sentence with an ellipsis.
actions.diagnosis: Cookbook taglines embedded series/episode numbering at the start of the string, and truncateDesc cut at 155 characters with '…' whenever the second sentence exceeded 155 characters.
actions.proposed_change: Extract series labels into model badges in buildCookbookModel, strip series prefixes in cleanSeoDescription, summarize descriptions at clean sentence/clause boundaries<=155 chars in summarizeSeoDescription, and wire seoTitle/seoDescription in prerender.js, RecipePage.jsx, and CookbookDetailPage.jsx.
actions.effort_assumptions: Shared helper in src/utils/recipeSchema.js consumed by prerender.js, useMeta.js, and recipeModel.js.
acceptance_tests: 0 of 213 prerendered indexable routes contain mid-sentence '…' truncation in meta[name=description] or og:description.
0 cookbook meta descriptions, JSON-LD descriptions, or visible hooks begin with CrumblCreamiCut Week, Proffee Episode, or Snack Box Series Ep.

measurement.metric: Count of indexable routes with series-prefix-polluted or ellipsis-truncated meta descriptions
measurement.baseline: 41 series-prefix-polluted cookbook descriptions and 96 ellipsis-truncated recipe meta descriptions
measurement.proposed_target: 0 series-prefix-polluted descriptions and 0 ellipsis-truncated meta descriptions across all 213 indexable routes
measurement.comparison_window: Immediate build verification across dist/*/index.html; 28-day organic CTR comparison in Search Console once available.
measurement.guardrail: Keep series identity visible as a badge chip on the page while leading prose and meta descriptions with the actual dish.

actions.priority_rationale: Searchers scan titles and snippets for dish identity, protein, and cooking method rather than internal series numbering or cut-off sentences.

actions.title: Strengthen internal linking on /dinners and RecipeDetail, add visible author bylines, and clean taxonomy
actions.score_rationale: All 60 dinners linked exclusively to /cookbook/money-mustard in RelatedRecipes, /dinners lacked a categorized static HTML directory at the bottom, RecipeDetail lacked a visible author link to /about, and 4 taxonomy tags were unclassified.
actions.diagnosis: RelatedRecipes hardcoded Money Mustard for every dinner instead of matching relevant Cookbook sauces/bases, DinnersPage relied only on its card grid without a protein-grouped directory section, and taxonomy.js lacked entries for 'quick', 'high-protein', and 'build'.
actions.proposed_change: Add a 'Browse all family dinners by protein' directory section to DinnersPage, make RelatedRecipes surface matching Cookbook sauces/bases (retaining Money Mustard for spicy-chicken-sandwich and default), add a visible 'By Tushar Sharma' link to /about on RecipeDetail, and classify the 4 tags in taxonomy.js.
actions.effort_assumptions: Template-level updates in DinnersPage.jsx, RecipeDetail.jsx, and taxonomy.js.
acceptance_tests: dist/dinners/index.html contains the protein-grouped dinner directory with descriptive links to all dinner recipes.

measurement.metric: Distinct Cookbook power-ups linked from dinner pages and taxonomy warning count
measurement.baseline: 1 cookbook item linked from dinner RelatedRecipes (/cookbook/money-mustard); 4 taxonomy warnings
measurement.proposed_target: Context-matched Cookbook sauces/bases linked across dinners (with Money Mustard retained on spicy-chicken-sandwich and default); 0 taxonomy warnings
measurement.guardrail: Preserve existing curated link from spicy-chicken-sandwich to /cookbook/money-mustard with descriptive anchor text.

actions.priority_rationale: Internal hub and cross-collection links distribute crawl equity and help readers navigate between dinners and component sauces/bases.
